1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One horizontal lantern with constant scale and independently changing travel times.
1.natural_language: Guide the pilgrim along the illuminated path. Lift the vellum from each picture to discover its sigil and lantern. Pan and zoom each window to match its moving lantern. The path fades and the pilgrim retreats when any window loses registration. Reach the shrine before the page burns out. full.summary: Right-click a picture to peel its opaque vellum and reveal its seeded sigil/lantern. Drag headers to swap pictures; drag acetate from the tray onto a picture, drag inside it to pan, and wheel to resize. Later right-clicks lift acetate for correction; inspection never stops an active journey.

simplified.summary: Use the picture’s lift button to peel its opaque vellum and reveal the same seeded sigil/lantern. Select a header then its destination; select acetate then its picture; click a pan position and use minus/plus to resize. Later lifts remove acetate for correction; inspection never stops an active journey.
